Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The agent made a critical error in data interpretation and verification. In Step 3, the agent claimed that the first time Apple's stock exceeded $50 was in July 2019 based on a search result stating the price was $51.05 in July 2019. This contradicts the ground truth (2018) and historical reality. Apple's stock price crossed $50 in 2018 (specifically around May/June 2018). The agent failed to recognize that the search result it cited likely referred to a later instance of the price being above $50, or it misinterpreted the "first time" constraint. By accepting a single data point ($51.05 in July 2019) as the definitive "first" occurrence without verifying if the price had been above $50 in prior years (like 2018), the agent provided an incorrect answer. This represents a failure in logical deduction and fact-checking against known historical timelines, similar to the error patterns seen in Example 6 where an agent misaligned temporal context or drew incorrect conclusions from incomplete data.
